sources.title: IndiaAI Compute Capacity — Government of India
claims: As outlined on the official IndiaAI compute portal [55], the initiative aims to democratize access to high-performance computing for domestic researchers and startups.
sources.quote: Under the IndiaAI Compute Pillar, the Mission is developing a scalable AI computing ecosystem to support India's growing AI startup and research community.
sources.reason: The page confirms that the IndiaAI Compute Pillar is developing scalable AI computing infrastructure to support India's AI startup and research community.

sources.title: Nvidia OpenAI Lease Guarantee — Unite.ai
claims: OpenAI Ohio Project | Data Center Lease Guarantee | $105 Billion | Unite.ai
sources.quote: NVIDIA has agreed to guarantee up to $105 billion in lease obligations at a planned 8-gigawatt AI data center campus in Pike County, Ohio, in a deal that makes the chipmaker the financial backstop for one of the largest single compute buildouts yet disclosed.
sources.reason: The source confirms that NVIDIA is guaranteeing up to $105 billion in lease obligations for an 8-GW Ohio AI data center campus leased by OpenAI.
